message.content: Install QuillCache with `pip install quillcache` (requires Python 3.9+). For plotting helpers, run `pip install quillcache[viz]` (requires matplotlib). By default the cache is stored in `~/.quillcache`; override the location by setting the `QUILLCACHE_HOME` environment variable before importing.
